INSERT INTO shopwizard.tShpReturnDirect ( OrderNo, OrderProdNo, OrderChangeNo, OrderType, ChnlCode, ChnlOrderNo, ChnlOrderProdNo, OrderName, OrderPhoneNo, OrderMobileNo, RecverName, RecverPhoneNo, RecverMobileNo, RecverZipcode, RecverAddr, DeliMemo, OrderMemo, DeliHopeDate, SupplyCode, SupplyName, ShopCode, ShopName, BundleYn, StoreCode, ProdCode, ShopProdCode, ProdName, ProdImg, MakerName, ModelName, ProdUnit, ProdMemo01, ItemCode, ItemName, ProdQty, VatRate, VatAmt, OfferYn, ListPrice, PrevPrice, SalePrice, SaleDiscntAmt, CustCpnDiscntAmt, ProdCpnDiscntAmt, PointUseAmt, SupplyPrice, BuyPrice, NvPrice, PvPrice, PointSaveAmt, DeliFeeId, DeliFeeType, DeliFeeAmt, PromotFeeAmt, OrderState, ReturnReason, ReturnReasonDetail, ExchngReason, ExchngReasonDetail, ReturnReciptDate, ReturnRqstDate, State, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate ) SELECT #{orderNo}, #{orderProdNo}, #{orderChangeNo}, #{orderType}, O.ChnlCode, OP.ChnlOrderNo, OP.ChnlOrderProdNo, O.OrderName, O.OrderPhoneNo, O.OrderMobileNo, O.RecverName, O.RecverPhoneNo, O.RecverMobileNo, O.RecverZipcode, CONCAT(O.RecverAddr1,' ',O.RecverAddr2), O.DeliMemo, O.OrderMemo, O.DeliHopeDate, OP.SupplyCode, OP.SupplyName, OP.ShopCode, OP.ShopName, OP.BundleYn, OP.StoreCode, OP.ProdCode, OP.ShopProdCode, OP.ProdName, OP.ProdImg, OP.MakerName, OP.ModelName, OP.ProdUnit, OP.ProdMemo01, OP.ItemCode, OP.ItemName, OP.ProdQty, OP.VatRate, OP.VatAmt, 0, OP.ListPrice, OP.PrevPrice, OP.SalePrice, OP.SaleDiscntAmt, OP.CustCpnDiscntAmt, OP.ProdCpnDiscntAmt, OP.PointUseAmt, OP.SupplyPrice, OP.BuyPrice, OP.NvPrice, OP.PvPrice, OP.PointSaveAmt, OP.DeliFeeId, OP.DeliFeeType, OP.DeliFeeAmt, OP.PromotFeeAmt, '반품요청', OP.ReturnReason, OP.ReturnReasonDetail, OP.ExchngReason, OP.ExchngReasonDetail, OP.ReturnReciptDate, NOW(), 1, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW() FROM shopion.tOrdOrder O INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrderProd OP ON O.OrderNo = OP.OrderNo WHERE OP.OrderNo = #{orderNo} AND OP.OrderProdNo = #{orderProdNo}
